rows.desc: 2026/06/11 - 2026/07/19 | Austin stands at a pivotal moment. In a year when the FIFA World Cup transforms North America into the center of global attention our city a capital of creativity innovation and cultural convergence deserves a worldclass celebration that reflects its identity. Austin was not selected as a host city but that reality does not diminish its spirit; instead it fuels our determination to deliver the most ambitious technically flawless and communitydriven unofficial World Cup festival in the United States. The Austin Soccer Fest is our response to this moment: a 39day immersive experience built with engineeringgrade planning internationalevent discipline and the emotional energy that only football can generate.Designed as a temporary urban park adjacent to Rainey Street the festival transforms a simple open lot into a vibrant safe and meticulously organized arena for residents visitors families and football fans. Our approach combines worldclass production standards honed over three decades in Formula 1 Olympic operations global hospitality and multiple FIFA World Cups with the authenticity and creative soul that define Austin. Every element of the project reflects a commitment to operational excellence: controlled crowd flow multilayer safety planning ADAcompliant infrastructure traffic mitigation neighborhood stewardship and a zerocompromise approach to compliance with ACE Fire APD ATD Public Health and TABC.This document presents the Austin Soccer Fest not as an event but as a citybuilding initiative a cultural asset designed to unite Austin around the worlds most popular sport. With responsible planning transparent communication and an unwavering focus on safety and quality we intend to deliver the most elevated inclusive and technically robust football festival the city has ever experienced. Austin deserves nothing less

rows.desc: 2026/06/11 - 2026/07/19 | Austin stands at a pivotal moment. In a year when the FIFA World Cup transforms North America into the center of global attention our city a capital of creativity innovation and cultural convergence deserves a worldclass celebration that reflects its identity. Austin was not selected as a host city but that reality does not diminish its spirit; instead it fuels our determination to deliver the most ambitious technically flawless and communitydriven unofficial World Cup festival in the United States. The Austin Soccer Fest is our response to this moment: a 39day immersive experience built with engineeringgrade planning internationalevent discipline and the emotional energy that only football can generate.Designed as a temporary urban park adjacent to Rainey Street the festival transforms a simple open lot into a vibrant safe and meticulously organized arena for residents visitors families and football fans. Our approach combines worldclass production standards honed over three decades in Formula 1 Olympic operations global hospitality and multiple FIFA World Cups with the authenticity and creative soul that define Austin. Every element of the project reflects a commitment to operational excellence: controlled crowd flow multilayer safety planning ADAcompliant infrastructure traffic mitigation neighborhood stewardship and a zerocompromise approach to compliance with ACE Fire APD ATD Public Health and TABC.This document presents the Austin Soccer Fest not as an event but as a citybuilding initiative a cultural asset designed to unite Austin around the worlds most popular sport. With responsible planning transparent communication and an unwavering focus on safety and quality we intend to deliver the most elevated inclusive and technically robust football festival the city has ever experienced. Austin deserves nothing less

rows.desc: 2026/02/21 | (2026/02/17) | This is a private wedding at the Commodore Perry Estate venue 4100 Red River St Austin 78751. We will be putting up a platform and tent for the event. In the tent there will be dinner served and then a wedding reception. This project consists of the installation of a temporary elevated platform and 50 x 120 clear-span structure tent within the Sunken Garden at the Commodore Perry Estate for a private wedding event hosting approximately 170 guests. The event will take place on Saturday February 21 from 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Installation will begin Wednesday February 18 at 9:00 AM. Work will commence with construction of the full elevated flooring system. The platform will be constructed using ring-lock scaffolding with screw jacks and base plates supporting 6x6 wood beams and plywood decking with a vinyl overlay finish. Due to existing site slope platform elevation will vary from approximately 12 inches at the northeast corner to approximately 24 inches at the southwest corner. Heating ducts will be routed beneath the platform and will not penetrate tent walls. Stairs will be installed at both the front and rear of the structure to provide primary and secondary egress. An ADA-accessible ramp will be installed along the left (mansion-facing) side of the platform to accommodate guests and service access. On Thursday February 19 flooring installation will continue and the structure tent frame and top will be installed. On Friday February 20 final detailing and installation will be completed with 100% turnover to the client by 12:00 PM to allow vendor load-in. The tent will be anchored using engineered concrete ballast blocks. No permanent foundations or ground penetrations are proposed. The structure is fully temporary and will be removed during a two-day strike on Sunday February 22 and Monday February 23
